sourceEnglish.title: Read the Hotel's Allergen Chart Before the Buffet
sourceEnglish.objective: Read a printed allergen chart with staff, flag what is out of date, and explain what to verify before eating.
sourceEnglish.speaking: You are reading the hotel's allergen chart with the AI, host Renzo, for your partner Elif, who is allergic to sesame: go through each bread and spread, ask clear questions, and say what to check using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que.
englishWordAnchors: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.
My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
Better not eat anything without confirming it first.
englishGrammarExamples: Before trying the bread, you have to read the label.
After talking to the kitchen, Renzo will confirm the ingredients for us.
englishReading: In the dining room of a hotel in Miraflores, in Lima, Elif and I arrive early for the breakfast buffet.
I tell Elif: Before you serve yourself anything, we need to confirm the chart with Renzo.
Renzo, the host, brings us the printed allergen chart and puts it on the table.
I explain to Renzo: My partner is allergic to sesame, even to traces.
After reading the first column, I ask him: Excuse me, what date is this allergen chart from?
Renzo points to the date last updated, March 3, but the hotel has had a new bread supplier since September.
I read aloud: The chart says the French roll doesn't contain sesame.
But the sliced bread from the new supplier has seeds on top, and the chart says nothing about that.
I tell Renzo: If the chart isn't up to date, we need to check each label.
Then I ask him: Could you ask the head chef for the supplier's label?
While Renzo goes to the kitchen, I tell Elif: After reading the label, I'll tell you what you can eat.
After talking to the head chef, Renzo comes back with the spec sheet for the sliced bread and the label for the French roll.
The spec sheet confirms that the seeds on the sliced bread are sesame.
The French roll's label says: May contain traces of sesame.
So I tell Elif: Better not eat anything without confirming it first.
Renzo explains that the head chef can make scrambled eggs with separate utensils, with only egg, salt and butter.
Before eating, Elif checks that she has her epinephrine auto-injector in her bag.
I explain to Renzo that if Elif has an allergic reaction, we have to use the auto-injector as her doctor instructed and call an ambulance.

lessons.title: Check an outdated breakfast allergen chart
lessons.objective: Read the hotel's allergen chart with staff, notice a supplier change, and request current ingredient and preparation details before anyone with a sesame allergy chooses food.
lessons.focus: 食べる前に and 確認した後で sequence checks; ～かどうか asks whether the chart is current. ごまアレルギー, 微量, アレルギー反応 and アドレナリン自己注射器 name the source's clinical concepts directly.
lessons.scene: At a hotel breakfast buffet, one guest helps a companion with a sesame allergy ask the host about an old chart and a new bread supplier.

cards.ja: アドレナリン自己注射器

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 同行者はごまにアレルギーがあります。食べる前に、表示を一緒に確認できますか。
reader.en: My companion has a sesame allergy. Can we check the information together before eating?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: こちらが朝食のアレルゲン表示表です。
reader.en: Here is the breakfast allergen chart.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: この表の更新日はいつですか。
reader.en: When was this chart last updated?

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: 三月の更新です。パンの仕入れ先は先月変わりました。
reader.en: It was updated in March. Our bread supplier changed last month.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: では、パンの情報が最新かどうか確認したいです。
reader.en: Then I would like to check whether the bread information is current.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: 今の表示ラベルと仕様書を厨房に確認します。調理器具についても聞きます。
reader.en: I will check the current label and specification with the kitchen. I will also ask about utensils.

reader.speaker: Companion
reader.ja: 確認が済むまで、私は食べずに待ちます。
reader.en: I will wait without eating until the checks are complete.

reader.speaker: Host
reader.ja: 厨房から回答をもらいましたが、混入の可能性を確認できません。
reader.en: The kitchen responded, but we cannot verify the cross-contact risk.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 分かりました。確認できない食品は選びません。
reader.en: Understood. We will not choose food that cannot be verified.

reader.speaker: Companion
reader.ja: ほかの選択肢について、担当者に相談しましょう。
reader.en: Let's ask the appropriate staff member about other options.

reader.speaker: Companion
reader.ja: アドレナリン自己注射器がかばんにあることも確認しました。
reader.en: I also checked that my epinephrine auto-injector is in my bag.

speaking.opening: この表示表はいつ更新されましたか。
speaking.goal: Ask the chart date and supplier, request the current label, and explain the companion's sesame allergy and auto-injector information.
speaking.closure: Summarize which labels and preparation details staff confirmed and which remain unresolved.

sourceEnglish.title: Breakfast Room Closed: Propose a Fair Alternative
sourceEnglish.objective: Explain what the booking promised and what you found, then propose a reasonable breakfast alternative.
sourceEnglish.speaking: You are a hotel guest, and the AI is Yesenia, the receptionist in Cartagena: explain what your booking included and what you found this morning with the preterite and imperfect (bajé, estaba cerrada), then propose a fair alternative with ¿sería posible…?
englishWordAnchors: My booking included breakfast, and the confirmation said so.
I went down at 8 and the terrace was closed.
There was no notice in the elevator or in the room.
I understand it wasn't your fault, don't worry.
Would a voucher for the café next door be possible?
Could you check it with the management, please?
If that's not possible, would you take the breakfast off my bill?
That seems like a fair solution, thank you very much.
englishGrammarExamples: I went down at 8 and the terrace was still closed.
The booking included breakfast, so would a voucher be possible?
englishReading: Daniel, a Canadian traveler, is spending three nights at a boutique hotel in the walled city of Cartagena.
He made the booking on a booking platform and paid the full price in advance.
According to the terms of the booking, breakfast on the terrace was included every day.
This morning Daniel goes to the front desk and talks with Yesenia, the receptionist.
Daniel: My booking included breakfast, and the confirmation said so.
Daniel: I went down at 8 and the terrace was closed.
Daniel: There was no notice in the elevator or in the room.
Yesenia: I'm very sorry, last night there was a leak and some urgent repairs started on the terrace.
Yesenia: It's a temporary closure, and nobody managed to put up the notice before 7.
Daniel: I understand it wasn't your fault, don't worry.
Daniel: I'm not looking for a refund, I just need an alternative for breakfast today.
Daniel: Would a voucher for the café next door be possible?
Daniel: If that's not possible, would you take the breakfast off my bill?
Yesenia: That seems reasonable to me, but any compensation has to be approved by the management.
Daniel: Could you check it with the management, please?
Yesenia calls her boss and, after 5 minutes, hands Daniel a voucher for a full breakfast.
Yesenia: In addition, we're offering you a 10% discount on the bill for the inconvenience.
Daniel: That seems like a fair solution, thank you very much.

lessons.title: Negotiate breakfast after a hotel closure
lessons.objective: Explain that breakfast was included in a booking, describe the closed dining room, and ask staff for an approved alternative or billing adjustment.
lessons.focus: 予約には～が含まれていました states the booking term; 今朝行ったら～でした reports what was found; ～していただけますか makes a polite proposal. Present a voucher or adjustment as a request requiring hotel approval, never a guaranteed entitlement.
lessons.scene: A guest calmly discusses an unexpectedly closed hotel breakfast room with the front-desk clerk.

cards.ja: 予約には朝食が含まれていました
cards.en: breakfast was included in the booking

cards.ja: 対応をお願いできますか

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 予約確認書には朝食付きと書いてあります。
reader.en: My booking confirmation says breakfast is included.

reader.speaker: Clerk
reader.ja: はい。今朝は朝食会場が急な工事で休業しています。
reader.en: Yes. The breakfast room is closed this morning for urgent repairs.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 八時に行ったら閉まっていて、お知らせも見つかりませんでした。
reader.en: I went there at eight and found it closed, with no notice that I could find.

reader.speaker: Clerk
reader.ja: ご案内が遅れてしまい、申し訳ありません。
reader.en: I am sorry we were late to inform you.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 今日の朝食について、代案をご相談できますか。
reader.en: Could we discuss an alternative for today's breakfast?

reader.speaker: Clerk
reader.ja: 近くの店の食事券を出せるか、責任者に確認します。
reader.en: I will ask the manager whether we can offer a voucher for a nearby café.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: それが難しければ、朝食分の料金調整は可能ですか。
reader.en: If that is difficult, could the breakfast charge be adjusted?

reader.speaker: Clerk
reader.ja: どちらの対応が可能か確認して、すぐにお伝えします。
reader.en: I will check which option is possible and let you know shortly.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: ありがとうございます。確認できるまでこちらで待ちます。
reader.en: Thank you. I will wait here until you can confirm.

reader.speaker: Clerk
reader.ja: 責任者の承認が取れました。食事券をお渡しします。
reader.en: The manager approved a voucher. Here it is.

speaking.opening: 予約確認書には朝食付きと書いてありますが、会場が閉まっています。
speaking.goal: State the confirmed booking term and the observed closure, then ask about an approved voucher or billing adjustment.
speaking.closure: Confirm the actual remedy and its terms with staff; do not promise compensation or a specific discount.

sourceEnglish.title: No Oat Milk Today: Choose Substitutes for the Group
sourceEnglish.objective: Compare the available milk options for each person and agree on a plan until the delivery arrives.
sourceEnglish.speaking: You are ordering for your friends, and the AI is Matías, a server at a San Telmo confitería: compare the milk options with más/menos … que, pick one for vegan Hannah and one for lactose-avoiding Dev, and plan the rest with ir a and the future (va a llegar, volveremos).
englishWordAnchors: the milk with a drop of coffee
What time is the delivery going to arrive?
Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.
The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
What do you think, Hannah? The coconut one is less thick.
Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.
englishGrammarExamples: The soy one is thicker than the almond one.
The delivery will arrive in the afternoon; meanwhile, Hannah is going to try the coconut one.
englishReading: One Saturday at 10, Nora walks into a café-bakery in San Telmo with her friends Hannah and Dev to have breakfast.
The server, Matías, tells them that there is no oat milk today because the delivery hasn't arrived yet.
Nora: What time is the delivery going to arrive?
Matías: It will arrive in the afternoon, and meanwhile I can offer you another plant-based drink.
Matías: We have soy milk and almond milk, which are the ones vegan customers ask for most.
Nora: Is the soy one thicker than the almond one?
Matías: Yes, the soy one is thicker, and the coconut milk has a sweeter taste than both.
Hannah: I prefer the soy one, because it makes more foam than the coconut one.
Nora: Hannah is vegan, so she's going to have the soy one.
Dev avoids lactose, so Matías recommends the lactose-free milk to him.
Nora: Dev, does the lactose-free one work for you for now?
Dev: Yes, I'm going to order a lágrima, because it has less coffee than a cortado.
Nora: The butter croissants contain dairy, right?
Matías: Yes, but according to the baker, the beef-fat croissant has no butter or milk, although it does contain beef fat.
Nora: Then Dev is going to eat two beef-fat croissants, and Hannah is going to order a fruit salad.
Nora: Could you bring us one with soy and one lactose-free?
Matías: Of course, and when the delivery arrives, I'm going to save some oat milk for you.
Nora: For now we'll order this, and we'll come back in the afternoon.

lessons.title: Plan substitutes when oat milk is unavailable
lessons.objective: Compare available drink options for two friends with different preferences, verify ingredients and preparation with staff, and agree on a temporary plan.
lessons.focus: ～より and ～のほうが compare drink options; ～が届くまで sets a temporary period. ヴィーガン and 乳糖を避けています describe two different dietary needs, while 乳糖を含まない牛乳 is still dairy milk.
lessons.scene: A group at a café learns that oat milk is out of stock and asks staff what can actually be prepared for each person.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: 今日はオーツミルクが在庫切れです。入荷は午後の予定です。
reader.en: We are out of oat milk today. A delivery is expected this afternoon.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 豆乳とアーモンドミルクはありますか。
reader.en: Do you have soy milk and almond milk?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: 両方ありますが、飲み物によって使える種類が違います。
reader.en: We have both, but the options vary by drink.

reader.speaker: Hana
reader.ja: 私はヴィーガンです。豆乳の飲み物の原材料と調理方法を確認できますか。
reader.en: I am vegan. Could you check the ingredients and preparation of the soy drink?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: 厨房に確認します。今は適していると断言できません。
reader.en: I will check with the kitchen. I cannot confirm suitability yet.

reader.speaker: Dev
reader.ja: 私は乳糖を避けています。乳糖を含まない牛乳は選べますか。
reader.en: I avoid lactose. Is lactose-free dairy milk an option?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.ja: あります。ただし、牛乳由来です。原材料も確認します。
reader.en: We have it, but it is dairy milk. I will check the ingredients too.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.ja: 確認が終わるまで、飲み物は決めずに待ちましょう。
reader.en: Let's wait to choose drinks until the checks are done.

reader.speaker: Hana
reader.ja: 確認できたら、豆乳とアーモンドミルクを比べたいです。
reader.en: Once you have checked, I would like to compare soy and almond milk.

reader.speaker: Dev
reader.ja: 入荷までの代わりが決まったら、今日はそれを注文します。
reader.en: If we find a substitute until the delivery, I will order that today.

speaking.opening: オーツミルクがない場合、ほかにどんな選択肢がありますか。
speaking.goal: Ask about two substitutes, compare them, distinguish vegan preference from lactose avoidance, and request ingredient/preparation checks before ordering.
speaking.closure: Confirm each person's chosen drink and the expected delivery time with staff.

modes.say: Coordinate the order while keeping unverified choices open.
